title: Yarn registry configured over cleartext
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a Yarn registry URL that uses cleartext http. Packages and authentication headers cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute the tarball the lockfile recorded.
remediation: Point `npmRegistryServer` at an https endpoint with a valid certificate.
limitation: It matches a Yarn registry URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
